description.value:
While it scarcely qualifies as a submachine gun, the EPL-13 boasts a complicated internal mechanism that shreds fired rounds into a spread of high-speed projectiles, which most consumers have chalked up to magic. The end result is the hardest-hitting submachine gun on the market. Even MAX-TAC have a few.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild, Silencer • Mods: None

Special Features: Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional point of SP. When rolling for Autofire damage with this weapon, roll 3d6 and drop the lowest roll before applying the multiplier.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild, Silencer (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
